dogs.name: Gordon
dogs.description: Meet Gordon! Gordy came to us during one of the hardest moments of his life. His family, facing heartbreaking circumstances, was told he would be euthanized if surrendered to a local shelter. Desperate to save him, they reached out to rescues — and we said yes. And we are so glad we did. Gordy is young, happy, and full of love. He didn’t deserve to suffer — and despite everything, his gentle heart is still wide open. He’s a sweet, slightly shy boy who has lived peacefully with three small dogs and truly enjoys the company of other pups (he has a soft spot for Chihuahuas!). He’s crate trained, potty trained, and wonderfully well-mannered — the kind of dog who quietly fits into your routine and your heart. Right now, Gordy needs a little extra care. He’s battling severe allergies, a skin infection, and a serious ear infection — one of the toughest we’ve seen. We’re doing everything we can:

When she arrived at our rescue, she was a devoted mom to six adorable puppies. She did an incredible job raising her little family, and now that every puppy is thriving, it's finally Mystery's turn to be the one cared for and loved. This sweet girl is ready to spread her wings and find the forever home she's been waiting for. Mystery isn't just beautiful—she's incredibly smart! Girl's Got Skills !! She absolutely loves playing fetch and already knows how to sit and patiently wait for her next throw. Watching her learn is a joy, and we have a feeling she'd be an absolute superstar at agility or other canine sports. dogs.name: Panda
dogs.breed: American Pit Bull Terrier / Australian Cattle Dog
dogs.description: URGENT Panda & Okapi Need Your Help Panda and Okapi are 3.5 month-old herding breed/Pit Bull mix sisters who have beaten incredible odds just to be here today. Before arriving from Bakersfield they were tiny puppies suffering from pneumonia, they watched nearly their entire litter disappear. Four siblings died in the shelter, two more died in foster care, and another was euthanized at the hospital. Against all odds, Panda and Okapi survived. Panda, the black-and-white sister, is the gentle, shy girl who likes to take her time. Okapi, the tricolored sister, is fearless, affectionate, and never turns down a belly rub or the chance to give kisses. Today, their journey took another heartbreaking turn. Okapi was found to have a broken growth plate in her rear leg and will need surgery to repair it. Once her surgery is complete, Okapi will need a quiet foster home where she can safely recover,

dogs.name: *KATIA
dogs.description: Patience Is Her Love Language Katia is the kind of dog who won`t ask for your heart right away—but with a little patience, she`ll quietly earn it. The shelter has been overwhelming for this sweet girl. When you first meet her, she may try to make herself as small as possible while she figures out if the world is safe. But if you give her a little space and let her move at her own pace, you`ll see her courage begin to shine. Once Katia starts to relax, she reveals a smart and gentle side. She`s very treat motivated and already knows `sit,` `shake,` and `down.` She enjoys exploring the yard, and before long, she begins choosing to come over for snacks, gentle pets, and a little human company. Katia is still learning that new people can be trusted, so she`ll do best with an adopter who respects her boundaries and lets the friendship grow naturally. dogs.description: THIS IS A COURTESY POST. Please contact Sheryl with OAKDALE TINY PAWS RESCUE, text+1 (209) 606-3640 or email at tinypawsoakdale@gmail.com, Pippi is being fostered in Modesto. Pippi is a 2-year-old Cattle Dog mix with the biggest heart. She is spayed; house trained, knows basic commands, weighs 50 pounds, loves kids, and absolutely loves to cuddle. She gets along well with other dogs, although her playful, high-energy personality can sometimes be a little much for more laid-back pups. She is curious about cats but has done well around them and doesn’t bother them much. Pippi is happiest when she has room to run and something to do. She would thrive on a ranch, farm, or large property with an active family who can give her the time, attention, exercise, and purpose she craves. Our rescue is looking for a forever home where she will be treated like family and loved as much as she deserves.

She's had all her shots and spayed, too. Give us call today and find out about Reunion Rescue and Animals First foster to adopt program along with our lifesaving holistic system that keeps dogs out of the vet office.

dogs.description: Happy is the sweetest boy. We pulled him at the last minute when he was about to be euthanized. Proved to be kid - cat - dog - people friendly, Happy was fostered to adopt to a person who mis-represented themselves to our rescue and Happy was the one who suffered. He was brought to the person as a perfect little man, but when we were able to get him back, he didn't even know his name! We think the person just left him on his own in the backyard..TOTALLY AGAINST REUNION RESCUE REGULATIONS!! The person in question even kept the toys and gift box filled with doggy starter leashes, collars, halters, balls, a Topple toy and Kongs among other things. We are looking for a great loving home where Happy can learn to be happy again. He is in foster care and loves going to the beach. dogs.name: Mariah
dogs.description: Mariah is a very sweet, playful, and super friendly Cattle Dog/Jack Russel Terrier mix looking for her forever home. There is never a dull moment with her in the home. She is always looking play, cuddle, and be the center of attention. She's about 2 years old, weighs 40 pounds, and is full of joy and happiness. Mariah has been spayed, microchipped, and fully vaccinated. She is very smart, energetic, and sometimes goofy - bringing smiles to anyone that meets her. She is ready to be in a forever home with a loving family and eager to go out on adventures and have a fulfilling dog life. If you are looking for an active dog that is great with adults, children, and other dogs, then Mariah is the dog for you.

dogs.name: Mickey
dogs.description: Mickey is a very sweet, playful and affectionate 3-year old fostered Cattle Dog mix looking for his forever home. He is full of energy and loves to be the center of attention. He enjoys being around other dogs and people, he's great in the car, and he is crate-trained. Mickey has been neutered and microchipped, and he is all up to date on his vaccinations. He would be a great addition to any family looking for a sweet and fun dog to spend quality time with.
